summary.jira_connect: Jira connection saved for {{project}}; the first sync started.
summary.jira_disconnect_done: Jira disconnected from {{project}}; the local backlog is writable again.
summary.code_summary_queued: Summary of {{path}} queued; it arrives as file.summary_updated.
confirm.jira_connect: Connects {{project}} to Jira {{key}} at {{host}}. Specrails then syncs the board and writes status changes back to Jira.
confirm.jira_disconnect: Disconnects {{project}} from Jira {{key}}. Pending outbox operations are dropped and the local backlog becomes writable.
confirm.jira_transition: Moves the Jira issue of {{ref}} to "{{status}}".
confirm.plugins_uninstall: Uninstalls {{id}}: removes its MCP servers, installed files and state.
confirm.code_summary: Regenerates the AI summary of {{path}} (spends provider tokens).
error.headroom_provider: Headroom needs options.provider: claude or codex.
error.not_connected: Jira is not connected for {{project}}. Connect it with jira_connect.
error.webhook_not_found: No webhook {{id}}. List them with webhooks.
confirm.mobile_enable: Turns on the mobile gateway: a listener on the local network for paired phones.
confirm.mobile_revoke: Revokes the paired device {{device}}; it must pair again.
confirm.webhooks_url: Sends the app's events to {{url}} from now on.
confirm.mobile_rotate: Rotates the gateway certificate and revokes all {{devices}} paired devices; each must pair again.
summary.mobile_test_started: Building and installing on the {{platforms}} simulator; wait on the run.
summary.mobile_options: Mobile test: checkout builds {{platforms}}; {{devices}} Tapflow device(s) available.
summary.mobile_device_released: {{device}} shuts down after the grace period unless it is opened again.
